name: S-Class Bloodrager
body:
S-class bloodragers are sorcerers who adapted to a harsh world where their inherent magic wouldn’t manifest until they could survive on their own. By the time it does manifest, the sorcerer-turned-bloodrager is already a capable warrior in their own right, and while having access to sorcerous power is a benefit, it doesn’t define who they are any more than their choice of weapon.

Role: S-class bloodragers wade into battle weapon swinging, a terrifying blend of magical and martial prowess. Enemies who mistakenly think they can get away from the bloodrager soon learn the error of their decision as a ray cuts them down from range or a wall springs up, barring their escape. While not the most magically inclined, the bloodrager makes great use of the spells to which he does have access.

Alignment: Any.

Hit Die: d10.

Starting Wealth: 3d6 × 10 gp (average 105 gp.) In addition, an s-class bloodrager begins play with an outfit worth 10 gp or less.

Class Skills

The s-class bloodrager’s class skills are Acrobatics (Dex), Climb (Str), Craft (Int), Handle Animal (Cha), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (arcana) (Int), Perception (Wis), Ride (Dex), Spellcraft (Int), Survival (Wis), and Swim (Str).

Skill Ranks per Level: 4 + Int modifier.

Class Features

All of the following are class features of the s-class bloodrager.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

S-class bloodragers are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light armor, medium armor, and shields (except tower shields). A bloodrager can cast sorcerer spells while wearing light or medium armor and using a shield without incurring the normal arcane spell failure chance. This does not affect the arcane spell failure chance for arcane spells received from other classes. Like other arcane spellcasters, a bloodrager wearing heavy armor incurs a chance of arcane spell failure if the spell in question has somatic components.

Bloodline

S-class bloodragers begin play with a bloodline that determines a number of the abilities, feats, and spells to which they have access. A sample bloodline is provided at the end of this section for easy reference.

Bloodline Powers: An s-class bloodrager’s bloodline grants him bloodline powers at 1st level, 4th level, and every 4 levels thereafter (8th, 12th, and so on).
Bloodline Feats: At 6th level, and every 3 levels thereafter (9th, 12th, and so on), an s-class bloodrager’s bloodline grants him a choice of bloodline feats for which he must meet any prerequisites.
Bloodline Spells: At 7th, 10th, 13th, and 16th levels, an s-class bloodrager learns an additional spell derived from his bloodline. These spells are in addition to the number of spells given on Table: S-Class Bloodrager Spells Known.

These spells cannot be exchanged for different spells at higher levels.

Bloodrage (Ex)

At 1st level, an s-class bloodrager can bloodrage for a number of rounds per day equal to 4 + his Constitution modifier. This counts as the barbarian’s rage ability, except as noted here. For each level after 1st he possesses, the bloodrager can bloodrage for 2 additional rounds per day.

Temporary increases to Constitution, such as that gained from bear’s endurance, do not increase the total number of rounds that an s-class bloodrager can bloodrage per day. An s-class bloodrager can enter a bloodrage as a free action.

The total number of rounds of bloodrage per day is renewed after resting for 8 hours, although these hours need not be consecutive.

While in a bloodrage, an s-class bloodrager gains a +2 bonus on melee attack rolls, melee damage rolls, thrown weapon damage rolls, and Will saving throws. In addition, he takes a –2 penalty to Armor Class. He also gains 2 temporary hit points per Hit Die. These temporary hit points are lost first when a character takes damage, disappear when the bloodrage ends, and are not replenished if the bloodrager enters a bloodrage again within 1 minute of his previous bloodrage. While in a bloodrage, an s-class bloodrager cannot use any Charisma-, Dexterity-, or Intelligence-based skill (except Acrobatics, Fly, Intimidate, and Ride) or any ability that requires patience or concentration (such as spellcasting).

An s-class bloodrager can end his bloodrage as a free action, and is fatigued for 1 minute after a bloodrage ends.

An s-class bloodrager can’t enter a new bloodrage while fatigued or exhausted, but can otherwise enter a bloodrage multiple times per day. If an s-class bloodrager falls unconscious, his bloodrage immediately ends.

Greater Bloodrage (Ex)

At 11th level, the bonus on melee attack and damage rolls, as well as the temporary hit points per Hit Die increase to +3. In addition, when he enters bloodrage, the bloodrager can expend a 2nd-level or lower spell slot as a free action to cast a spell of that level, targeting only himself. If the spell has a duration greater than 1 round, it lasts for the duration of his bloodrage. This otherwise counts as the barbarian’s greater rage ability.

Tireless Bloodrage (Ex)

At 17th level, an s-class bloodrager no longer becomes fatigued at the end of his bloodrage.

Mighty Bloodrage (Ex)

At 20th level, choose one of the following options. This otherwise counts as the barbarian’s mighty rage ability.

The bonuses and temporary hit points from greater bloodrage increase to +4, and the spell slot the bloodrager can expend increases to 4th level or lower.

When the bloodrager enters a bloodrage, he can apply two spells to himself rather than one.

Fast Movement (Ex)

When an s-class bloodrager is not wearing heavy armor or carrying a heavy load, his base land speed increases by 10 feet.

Uncanny Dodge (Ex)

At 2nd level, a bloodrager can react to danger before his senses would normally allow him to do so. He cannot be caught flat-footed, nor does he lose his Dexterity bonus to AC if the attacker is invisible. He still loses his Dexterity bonus to AC if immobilized. A bloodrager with this ability can still lose his Dexterity bonus to AC if an opponent successfully uses the feint action against him.

If a bloodrager already possesses uncanny dodge from a different class, he automatically gains improved uncanny dodge (see below) instead.

Improved Uncanny Dodge

At 5th level, a bloodrager can no longer be flanked, which denies creatures the ability to sneak attack the bloodrager by flanking him, unless the attacker has at least four more levels in a class granting sneak attack than the bloodrager has bloodrager levels.

Blood Sanctuary (Su)

At 3rd level, due to the power of his blood, a bloodrager can stand confidently amid the effects of spells cast by himself or his allies. He gains a +2 bonus on saving throws against spells that he or an ally casts.

Eschew Materials (Ex)

At 4th level, an s-class bloodrager gains Eschew Materials as a bonus feat.

Spellcasting

Beginning at 4th level, a bloodrager gains the ability to cast a small number of arcane spells drawn from the sorcerer/wizard spell list. To learn or cast a spell, a bloodrager must have a Charisma score equal to at least 10 + the spell level.

He can cast spells he knows without preparing them ahead of time. The saving throw DC against a bloodrager’s spell is: 10 + the spell’s level + his Charisma modifier

Like other spellcasters, a bloodrager can cast only a certain number of spells of each level per day. His base daily spell allotment is given on Table: S-Class Bloodrager. In addition, he receives bonus spells per day if he has a high Charisma score. The bloodrager does not need to prepare his spells in advance; he can cast any spell he knows at any time, assuming he hasn’t yet used up his allotment of spells per day for the spell’s level. The bloodrager’s selection of spells is limited. At 4th level, a bloodrager knows two 1st-level spells of his choice. A bloodrager gains more spells as he increases in level, as indicated on Table: S-Class Bloodrager Spells Known. Unlike spells per day, the number of spells a bloodrager knows is not affected by his Charisma score, but it is affected by any bonus spells he gains from his bloodline. At 8th level and every 3 levels thereafter, a bloodrager can choose to learn a new spell in place of one he already knows. This swap follows all the same rules as for a sorcerer.

Damage Reduction (Ex)

At 7th level, a bloodrager gains damage reduction.

Subtract 1 from the damage the bloodrager takes each time he is dealt damage from a weapon or a natural attack.

At 10th level, and every 3 levels thereafter, this damage reduction increases by 1 point. Damage Reduction can reduce damage to 0, but not below 0.

Indomitable Will (Ex)

At 14th level, a bloodrager gains a +4 bonus on Will saves to resist enchantment spells while bloodraging. This bonus stacks with all other modifiers, including the morale bonus on Will saves he also receives during his bloodrage.

S-Class Bloodrager Spell Suggestions

The following is a list of suggested spells for easy reference while playing an s-class bloodrager. These spells are intentionally summarized here. If you would like to see the full rules for these spells, including at which levels other classes gain them, please refer to the individual resources.

1st-Level: Anticipate peril, burning hands, cause fear, daze monster, detect thoughts, disguise self, enlarge person, expeditious retreat, identify, mage armor, reduce person, resist energy, sleep
2nd-Level: Bear’s endurance, bestow curse, bull’s strength, cat’s grace, clairaudience/clairvoyance, eagle’s splendor, false life, fox’s cunning, glitterdust, haste, heroism, hold person, invisibility, owl’s wisdom, protection from energy, slow, tongues, versatile weapon, wind wall
3rd-Level: Black tentacles, deep slumber, dimension door, enlarge person (mass), fear, fly, invisibility (greater), lightning bolt, locate creature, reduce person (mass), remove curse, sending, scrying, vampiric touch
4th-Level: Animal growth, bear’s endurance (mass), blight, break enchantment, bull’s strength (mass), cat’s grace (mass), eagle’s splendor (mass), false vision, fox’s cunning (mass), hold monster, ice storm, legend lore, overland flight, owl’s wisdom (mass), plane shift, true seeing
